faq_heading: Forest Glen houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Forest Glen. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Forest Glen, Burnaby: 18 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 11 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Forest Glen fell from 20 in June to 18 in September (−10.0%), and 6 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 3.9% of Burnaby’s 458 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Forest Glen?
Forest Glen also had 64 condos and townhomes listed and 6 sold in September, against 18 houses listed. The Forest Glen condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Forest Glen home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

17 houses sold in Forest Glen with a median price of $2,122,000 (the middle half sold between $1,825,000 and $2,370,000), taking a median of 17 days to sell at 94.3% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $701 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median lot of 7,458 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Forest Glen?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 18 houses listed in Forest Glen. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Forest Glen a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Forest Glen had a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Forest Glen from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in Forest Glen over those 4 months, out of 199 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Forest Glen?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Forest Glen sell for?
faq.a: 17 houses sold in Forest Glen between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,122,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Forest Glen?
faq.a: The median was 17 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.3% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
